title: Site page record
description: One file of site/data/pages/<id>.json: the layers of one printed page as the viewer reads them. Written by scripts/split_pages.py from manifest.json, transcription/final/<id>.json and (later) the English sections. See docs/site-design.md §4. Its $defs also define reader mode's site/data/text/<section>.json (`section`) and site/data/text/toc.json (`toc`), which split_pages.py validates the same way.

id.description: page id, e.g. p004 or p000-title

page.description: true page number; null for the front matter, which is addressed by name

folio.description: the folio number as printed, which may disagree with `page`

image.description: image basename; the viewer builds book.images.base + image + book.images.ext

kind.description: cudl or gallica for the Coras book; other for another book's scans (with a per-page url in its manifest)

image_no.description: scan number in the source viewer; null when the source has no such number

english.description: null while the translation is pending

french.description: null while the transcription is pending

french_notes.description: [] when the page has no notes, null when the French layer is pending

readings.description: contested readings: where the two transcription passes disagreed, decided or still open (split_pages.contested_readings)

notes.description: sidenotes of an English paragraph, in the order their markers print

key.description: the letter printed as the marker, matching the French note key; null for a note the print sets with no key, or a quotation the translator moved into the notes

citation.description: the citation in English, may contain <i>

original.description: the citation as Coras printed it

gloss.description: a sentence of context, or null

target.description: blocks[i].lines[j], margin_notes[i].lines[j], foot_notes[i].lines[j] or blocks[i].text when the reading sits on one printed line; null for structure (page layout, running head, note keys)

spans.description: [start, end) UTF-16 offsets into the target line to underline; null when there is nothing to underline (no target, or readings that agree word for word)

aligned.description: false when the words could not be aligned and the span is the whole line

by.description: who decided: carson (the editor), reconciler (the first run's reconciliation model), translator (the translation model, from context), reviewer (the review model, whole-book pass), auto (deferred, open); null for an open arbitration with no decision entry

section.description: One translated section as reader mode reads it: site/data/text/<id>.json. Paragraphs are whole; page turns are empty <span class="pg" data-page> inside their html.

order.description: 1-based position of the section in text/sections.json

heading.description: the heading the section prints (ANNOTATION V, TEXT), normalized as the page files' heading blocks; null for the title page and the argument, whose display lines carry their own titles

kind.description: from the text/sections.json kind: texte is text

pages.description: the page ids the section's prose marks, in order, without repeats

notes.description: the notes whose markers this paragraph prints, in marker order, then any whose marker is missing and any with no key

key.description: the letter printed as the marker, matching the French note key; null for a note the print sets with no key, or a quotation the translator moved into the notes

page.description: the page the note is printed on; the viewer pairs a note with its marker on (page, key), since the letters restart on every page

citation.description: the citation in English, may contain <i>

original.description: the citation as Coras printed it

gloss.description: a sentence of context, or null

toc.description: site/data/text/toc.json: every translated section, in print order.

heading.description: the heading the section prints (ANNOTATION V, TEXT), normalized as the page files' heading blocks; null for the title page and the argument, whose display lines carry their own titles

kind.description: from the text/sections.json kind: texte is text

pages.description: the page ids the section's prose marks, in order, without repeats
